desc:
Want adventure and treasure? 👀 Well, look no further! In this game, you do just that building and sailing with a ship! 🔨

- 🎃 Halloween 2026 is coming soon! ⏰
- 4 *NEW* blocks are finally here! 🎉 

Inspired by the original... Build A Boat For Treasure by Chillz Studios!  🗣️🔥 Go show them support! ❤️

How do I play Building Boats? 🤔
It's simple, you build a boat, 🛠️ save it if you wish, 💾 and set sail to earn gold! 🤑 
Then, with that gold, you can build bigger and better boats! 💪

Don't forget to Like [👍] and Favorite [⭐] if you enjoyed!
Follow [🔔] our events if there are any! 💥

⚠️ CRASHING SERVERS IS BANNABLE 😡🔨

ⓘ "Building Boats" is not associated with, nor claims ownership of the "Build a Boat for Treasure" concept or intellectual property. Developed independently with intention of only providing a similar experience. All original trademarks and copyrights belong to their respective owners.
